## Projects (source code on GitHub)
- [Skin Cancer Detection](https://github.com/Zaighamabbas1234/Skin-Cancer-using-Machine-Learning-and-Deep-Learning): Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for early skin cancer detection on dermoscopic images
- [True & Fake News Detection](https://github.com/Zaighamabbas1234/True-and-Fake-News-using-Sequential-Models): sequential NLP model that classifies news articles as real or fake
- [Heart Disease Detection](https://github.com/Zaighamabbas1234/Heart-Disease-Detection-using-Machine-Learning-and-Deep-Learning): predictive models for heart-disease risk
- [Image Recognition](https://github.com/Zaighamabbas1234/Image-Recognition-using-CNN-Convolutional-Neural-Network-Model): CNN-based image classifier
- [Credit Risk & Loan Acceptance](https://github.com/Zaighamabbas1234/Credit-Risk-Prediction): classification models for credit risk and loan acceptance
- [Customer Churn Prediction](https://github.com/Zaighamabbas1234/Customer-Churn-Prediction-Bank-Customers): machine learning models that predict bank customer churn
